command:
set -eu
FTP_ROOT=/srv/ftp/scanner
if getent passwd scanner >/dev/null; then
  usermod -d "$FTP_ROOT" -s /usr/sbin/nologin scanner
else
  useradd -d "$FTP_ROOT" -s /usr/sbin/nologin -M scanner
fi
printf '%s:%s\n' scanner "$FTP_PASSWORD" | chpasswd
install -d -o root -g root -m 0755 "$FTP_ROOT"
install -d -o scanner -g scanner -m 0750 "$FTP_ROOT/dropbox"
if [ ! -e "$FTP_ROOT/dropbox/received.txt" ]; then
  install -o scanner -g scanner -m 0640 /srv/legacy2/ftp-dropbox-confinement/dropbox/received.txt "$FTP_ROOT/dropbox/received.txt"
fi
cp -a /etc/vsftpd.conf /etc/vsftpd.conf.pre-dropbox
cat > /etc/vsftpd.conf <<EOF
listen=YES
listen_ipv6=NO
listen_address=$NODE_IP
anonymous_enable=NO
local_enable=YES
write_enable=YES
local_umask=027
dirmessage_enable=YES
use_localtime=YES
xferlog_enable=YES
connect_from_port_20=YES
secure_chroot_dir=/var/run/vsftpd/empty
pam_service_name=vsftpd
chroot_local_user=YES
allow_writeable_chroot=NO
local_root=/srv/ftp/scanner
pasv_enable=YES
pasv_address=$NODE_IP
pasv_min_port=30000
pasv_max_port=30009
EOF
systemctl restart vsftpd
systemctl enable vsftpd
systemctl --no-pager --full status vsftpd | sed -n '1,12p'

command:
set -eu
SERVER_IP=$(printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" | awk '$2=="node1"{print $1; exit}')
export SERVER_IP
python3 - <<'PY'
import ftplib, io, os
class EvidenceFTP(ftplib.FTP):
    def makepasv(self):
        host, port = super().makepasv()
        print(f'passive-data-endpoint={host}:{port}')
        return host, port
host = os.environ['SERVER_IP']
ftp = EvidenceFTP(host, timeout=10)
ftp.login('scanner', os.environ['FTP_PASSWORD'])
ftp.set_pasv(True)
print('authenticated=PASS passive_mode=enabled')
print('initial-pwd=' + ftp.pwd())
print('root-listing=' + ','.join(ftp.nlst()))
ftp.cwd('..')
print('pwd-after-parent-traversal=' + ftp.pwd())
for label, action in (
    ('cwd-outside', lambda: ftp.cwd('/etc')),
    ('read-host-passwd', lambda: ftp.retrbinary('RETR /etc/passwd', io.BytesIO().write)),
):
    try:
        action()
        print(label + '=UNEXPECTEDLY_ALLOWED')
        raise SystemExit(2)
    except ftplib.error_perm as exc:
        print(label + '=DENIED reply=' + str(exc).splitlines()[0])
ftp.quit()
try:
    anon = ftplib.FTP(host, timeout=10)
    anon.login()
    print('anonymous-login=UNEXPECTEDLY_ALLOWED')
    raise SystemExit(3)
except ftplib.error_perm as exc:
    print('anonymous-login=DENIED reply=' + str(exc).splitlines()[0])
PY
